changes: Bank theme, typography, linear icons and shared card/button components; page CSS is scoped to .im-page.
Inline WeChat QR and connection management appear side by side on wide desktops, stacked on narrower viewports.
Visible three-step guide and QR placeholder, scan status, expiry/retry and explicit account confirmation.
Manual pairing-code form is collapsed by default, keyboard accessible, and automatically opens for #code links.
Reminder editor and reminder history are separated, with explicit Beijing time and independent list refresh controls.
Existing customer authentication, account ownership, QR API and reminder confirmation semantics are unchanged.
verificationLimits: Browser tests load the published HTML/CSS/JS, but all bank, Agent and IM API requests are intercepted as isolated fixtures.
Actual WeChat scanning and message delivery were not repeated for this UI-only release.
This release changes the customer web interface, not backend runtime code or the separate staff interface.
